about.en: Chirp is an IoT connectivity network on Sui that combines a DePIN of community-run gateways (such as its Blackbird miners) with a platform for managing IoT devices and their data. CHIRP is the network's reward and utility token, a Sui coin of type 0x1ef4c0b20340b8c6a59438204467ca71e1e7cbe918526f9c2c6c5444517cd5ca::chirp::CHIRP. It is unrelated to Chirper AI and Chirpley, which use similar tickers.
